admission.justification: A brief that restates role rules competes with the role and operation files; the brief must carry only the master's values and defer to them.

applicability: The two brief templates (manager, curator) and their value rows.
conditions: Brief rows carry leaf values; role and operation texts win on disagreement.
Only the approved message-carrier guidance is repeated across templates; no fixed limit or new role/start/write grant is introduced.
exclusions: Role and operation texts, which own the rules.

evidence: manager/worker/curator/architect brief cuts in rule1-table (goes rows); worker-brief gloss names bounded L-R/L-S exception per guideline rule 6

statement: Brief templates carry handed-over inputs and requested outputs; role/operation sources keep procedural authority. The specifically approved message/file/body/attach/settings/return guidance is a bounded shared transport exception, not permission to duplicate other role procedures.
